# Beaconmon

> Beaconmon is an uptime, performance, and competitor monitoring platform built for ecommerce stores, freelancers, and agencies.

Beaconmon checks your websites every 30 seconds and sends instant alerts when something breaks: downtime, slow responses, SSL certificate expiry, domain expiry, unexpected content changes, or competitor price drops. It is designed for freelancers, agencies, and small ecommerce businesses who need to stay ahead of site issues and track what competitors are doing.

## What Beaconmon does

- **HTTP uptime monitoring** — checks every 30 seconds (Scale plan) or 1 minute (Starter/Growth), alerts on non-2xx responses or slow load times
- **SSL certificate monitoring** — tiered warnings at 30, 14, and 7 days before expiry
- **Domain expiry tracking** — WHOIS-based alerts at 30, 14, and 7 days before renewal
- **TCP port monitoring** — verifies any port is open and accepting connections
- **Keyword monitoring** — confirms a word or phrase is (or isn't) present in the page body
- **Content change detection** — notifies when any HTML content changes at a CSS selector; tracks competitor prices, stock status, and copy changes
- **Competitor monitoring** — track competitor pricing pages and product listings; get alerts the moment anything changes
- **Intelligence Digest** — scheduled email and Slack digest summarizing uptime trends, anomalies, and competitor activity across all your monitors

## Alert channels

Email, Slack, webhook. SMS available on Scale plan.

## Public status pages

Every plan includes public status pages showing 90-day uptime history, active incidents, and incident history. Custom domains supported.

## Pricing

- **Free** — $0/month — 10 monitors, 5-minute check interval, 1 status page, 7-day history, no credit card required
- **Starter** — $29/month (or $23/month billed annually) — 25 monitors, 1-minute checks, 3 status pages, 30-day history, 5 competitor monitors
- **Growth** — $79/month (or $63/month billed annually) — 100 monitors, 1-minute checks, 10 status pages, 90-day history, 25 competitor monitors, multi-location checks, Intelligence Digest
- **Scale** — $199/month (or $159/month billed annually) — unlimited monitors, 30-second checks, unlimited status pages, 365-day history, unlimited competitor monitors, multi-location checks, Intelligence Digest, SMS alerts

All plans include a 14-day Growth trial with no credit card required.

## How Beaconmon compares to alternatives

**vs Distill** — Distill is a browser extension for manual page watching. Beaconmon is a hosted monitoring service with scheduled checks, team alerting, and a daily Intelligence Digest. Beaconmon runs checks automatically without a browser tab open and routes alerts to email, Slack, or webhook.

**vs Hexowatch** — Hexowatch monitors websites for visual, content, and code changes. Beaconmon is purpose-built for ecommerce: it classifies competitor changes by type (price drop, new product, copy change) and compiles them into a daily digest. Beaconmon also includes uptime monitoring and SSL/domain expiry alerts in every plan.

**vs Prisync** — Prisync is a dedicated competitor price intelligence tool that scrapes product prices at scale. Beaconmon tracks competitor pages as content monitors using CSS selectors, which works for any public page without requiring a structured product feed. Beaconmon pairs competitor tracking with uptime monitoring, SSL/domain expiry, and a daily Intelligence Digest in one platform.

**vs Visualping** — Visualping detects visual changes on web pages using screenshot comparison. Beaconmon uses HTML content diffing at a CSS selector level, which means changes are attributed to specific elements (price, stock status, hero copy) rather than a pixel diff. Beaconmon includes uptime monitoring, SSL/domain monitoring, and an automated daily brief.

**vs UptimeRobot** — UptimeRobot is a general-purpose uptime monitoring tool. Beaconmon adds ecommerce-specific competitor intelligence, content change detection, and a daily digest of competitor moves on top of the same core uptime checks.

**vs Pingdom** — Pingdom focuses on uptime and performance monitoring for large sites. Beaconmon is optimized for small ecommerce businesses and adds competitor tracking, content change detection, and Intelligence Digest features that Pingdom does not offer.

**vs Better Uptime** — Better Uptime offers on-call scheduling and incident management alongside uptime monitoring. Beaconmon does not do on-call routing but adds competitor intelligence and content monitoring tailored to ecommerce use cases.

**vs StatusCake** — StatusCake is a general-purpose uptime and SSL monitoring tool. Beaconmon adds ecommerce competitor intelligence, content change detection, and daily digests to the same foundation.
